summary: Native agent launches retain durable invocation receipts through admission, startup failure, cancellation, verified incarnation binding and runtime ending

replay.detail: No historical launch is invented or backfilled. Existing prepared operations remain readable; their future observed lifecycle transitions can produce receipts. Optional receipt metadata defaults to unknown.

schema.detail: Adds system-only durable harness.invocation metadata on agent subjects, immutable per invocation/phase/event source, and optional producer_version/invocation_id diagnostic fields. No usage or step execution schema is changed by launch capture.

rules.detail: Invocation receipts are retained as durable claims independently of local observations, timelines and trace sampling. Native launch environment receives FRACTAL_INVOCATION_ID before spawn. Existing operation cancellation and provenance fences remain authoritative.

compatibility.detail: Claim metadata is additive. Readers preserve unknown observations as null rather than guessing prompt hashes, context freshness, producer release, transcript or fallback reason. Launch-input fingerprints remain distinct from exact provider prompts. Older members need the expanded claim registry before accepting new receipt kinds.

downtime.detail: No fleet operation or startup migration is required by the source change.

manual.detail: No operator action or additional executable probe is introduced.

recovery.detail: Durable receipts preserve failed preclaim startup and cancelled queued admission. Restart recovery appends exact verified incarnation and closure evidence without rewriting earlier phases or fabricating usage. Preserve stores containing new claims when rolling back to a registry that does not recognize the new kind.
